subject.title: fix(security): add estimate-before-decode guard to base64 paths

question: Should `@openclaw/media-core/base64-size-limit` become a supported public package API for this internal validation helper?
rationale: The repository policy treats new package/plugin-facing API surfaces as compatibility-sensitive; keeping the helper private avoids committing to a public contract unless maintainers explicitly want one.

options.title: Keep the helper private
options.body: Remove the new package subpath and implement the CLI error formatting locally while provider paths keep using the existing base64 estimate helper.

options.title: Adopt a public media-core API
options.body: Retain the export only with explicit ownership, documented contract, and compatibility coverage for external consumers.

recommendation.title: Keep the helper private
recommendation.body: Remove the new package subpath and implement the CLI error formatting locally while provider paths keep using the existing base64 estimate helper.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work owns an adjacent CLI-runner execution boundary, though direct media-core ownership could not be established from the available review evidence.
